name: Interior Design Editorial
tagline: A complete 35-slide spatial editorial proposal with Tenor Sans, Poppins, warm neutrals, native process/pricing elements and independent photographic slots.

palette.description: Exact source beige, brown, white and black, with natural wood and clay colors supplied by independent source photographs.

typography.style: Exact source Tenor Sans 400 and Poppins 400 webfont faces embedded unchanged. The original 1920×1080 typography, tracked capitals, small captions, line heights and paragraph frame geometry are retained.

best_for: A complete spatial and object-design proposal with studio story, services, milestones, photographic concepts, material moodboards, object portfolios, design process, pricing and team profiles.
avoid_for: Dense financial dashboards, technical architecture diagrams, or materials without high-quality independent photographs and object images.
